description: This file defines the MonkeyRotationEvent class, which extends MonkeyEvent, and is responsible for simulating screen rotation events in the Android Monkey testing tool. It includes methods for constructing the event with a specified rotation degree and persistence, and for injecting the rotation event via IWindowManager and IActivityManager interfaces.

classes.name: MonkeyRotationEvent
classes.description: A class representing a rotation event in the Android Monkey testing framework, capable of triggering screen rotation changes on the device.

methods.name: MonkeyRotationEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a specified rotation degree and persistence setting.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the rotation event into the system, performing rotation lock/unlock depending on the parameters.
